bibliographic.description:
The one you loved has started his epic, without you. Is there any chance that you can follow him to Paradise?

FꙮLLOWER is a short IF Paradise Lost fangame written in free verse (because I suck at blank verse)! Follow Beelzebub as he journeys to Paradise to be with Satan... or at least, tries to. Maybe Chance will not be so kind.

Created for the Milton Marathon art exhibit! This is the public build, though. There will be a different (and private) art exhibit build with some mechanical differences.
